upcoming_events.title: Bloody Mary Festival
upcoming_events.description: 11th annual · Saturday, 11 AM–2 PM · unlimited Bloody Mary tastings from Emerald Coast restaurants and bars, live music, SEC football on the big screen and lawn games · $65 advance, $75 at the door, 21+ · benefits Habitat for Humanity · 25-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Harvest Wine & Food Festival
upcoming_events.description: 10th annual · four days in WaterColor — Celebrity Winemaker Dinners Thursday, Harvest After Dark Friday, the Grand Tasting Saturday Oct 17 in Cerulean Park (1–4 PM), and a Festival Brunch Sunday · benefits DCWAF children's charities · 10-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Baytowne Beer Festival
upcoming_events.description: 18th annual · Friday night's Backyard Bash (6–8 PM) kicks off tailgate-style with bourbon and bonfires under the stars; Saturday afternoon is the Grand Craft Beer Tasting, sampling from 150-plus breweries · advance tickets recommended · 25-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Halloweener Derby & Costume Contest
upcoming_events.description: 16th annual · Saturday Oct 24, 10 AM–2 PM at the Seaside Amphitheater · dachshund races down Central Square and an all-breeds costume contest · free to watch, bring the dog and a camera · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Seeing Red Wine Festival
upcoming_events.description: 34 years running · a vintners dinner at Bud & Alley's, the Al Fresco Reserve Tasting, Battle of the Somms, the Grand Tasting in Central Square, and a Celebration of Bubbles brunch · benefits DCWAF · sold out — join the waitlist at seasideseeingred.com · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Rosemary Beach Uncorked
upcoming_events.description: 15th annual · Saturday Nov 14, 2026, 1–4 PM on Barrett Square · wines poured by vintners from around the world alongside dishes from Rosemary Beach restaurants, with live music as you stroll the cobblestone streets · sold out — join the waitlist at rosemarybeachuncorked.com · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: 30A Farmers' Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sun 9–1 · About 30 vendors on Barrett Square every Sunday, 9 AM–1 PM — local produce and micro-greens, Gulf seafood off the boat, artisan breads and sweets, grass-fed beef, tupelo honey · pet-friendly · a great Sunday-morning outing · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Morning Vinyasa Yoga
upcoming_events.description: Through Oct 31 · Daily 8:30 AM · Every morning at 8:30 AM on the pavilion overlooking the Gulf, weather permitting · no preregistration, $25 drop-in by cash, check, or Venmo · bring a mat or towel and water · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Sounds of Seaside Concert Series
upcoming_events.description: Through Oct 28 · Wed 5–7 PM · Free Wednesday-evening concerts on the Seaside Amphitheater lawn, 5–7 PM, running weekly through Oct 28 · a different act each week, free and open to all ages · bring blankets and chairs, snacks and drinks welcome · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Central Square Cinema
upcoming_events.description: Through Oct 30 · Fri 8 PM · Free family movies on the big screen at the Seaside Amphitheater, Fridays at 8 PM — Hoppers (Oct 9), Hotel Transylvania (Oct 16), Coco (Oct 23), and a Halloween feature (Oct 30) · bring a blanket and the kids · 5-min walk or drive

copy.instagram:
Blue Moon is open Fri Oct 23 – Sun 25, three nights.

Saturday morning, the Halloweener Derby runs at the Seaside Amphitheater, 10 AM–2 PM — dachshund races and an all-breeds costume contest, free to watch. Seaside is five minutes by car.

Then back to Crystal Court for a quiet evening and a sky full of stars.

Link in bio to book the dates.

Book the three nights at book.sunandmoon30a.com.
